title: The rest of the panel still counts at two
goal: Hold two layers selected and most of the panel still talks like a tally: "Turns the shadow on or off for all 2 of them", "A color picked here takes all 2 of them off the style". The drop lines were fixed to say "both of them"; everywhere else in the panel should say it too, so one selection is not described two different ways an inch apart.
notes:
CrowdWords.them(_:) landed in Sources/PhotonzCore/CrowdWords.swift on 2026-09-12 and returns "both of them" / "all N of them" / nil for one. The drop lines (ColorDrop, TextStyleDrop) and EffectsListInspector already use it.

The sites still counting, read on 2026-09-12:
Sources/PhotonzCore/TextStyleLibrary.swift:438, Sources/PhotonzCore/EffectStyles.swift:537, Sources/PhotonzCore/ColorStyleSelection.swift:178, Sources/Photonz/PartsInspector.swift:324 and :327, Sources/Photonz/LayerEffectsInspector.swift:267 and :269, Sources/Photonz/ComponentPanel.swift:689 and :1865, Sources/Photonz/ColorStylePanel.swift:899 and :1004.

Core ones are test-first; check Tests/PhotonzCoreTests for pinned strings (most use 3, so they should pass unchanged) and add a two-selected case per sentence.
acceptance: With exactly two layers selected, no tooltip or panel note anywhere reads "all 2 of them"
